verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog states you can choose to auto-generate release notes in pipeline settings so the changelog stays up to date. This is a first-party, direct capability matching the story. However, it rests on a single one-line mention. Missing for 10: detail on how release notes are generated per release (sources, format, editing/review), explicit per-release scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review

citations.quote: Choose to auto-generate release notes in pipeline settings so your changelog is always up to date.
